title: A novel MOF-based electrochemical sensor for simultaneous quantification of nitrophenols in binary mixtures using artificial neural networks: challenges and opportunities
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,41400-41417
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03838C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Abolfazl Kiasadr, S. Maryam Sajjadi, Mehdi Baghayeri
A sensor based on a Ni-MOF-74/Fe3O4/β-CD-modified GCE enables simultaneous determination of 2-NP and 4-NP. The data suffers severely overlapping signals and nonlinearity problems, needing to be analyzed by an ANN technique.
